rules.title: PHP 8.1 is end-of-life
rules.summary: The PHP unsupported branches page lists the PHP 8.1 branch as end of life on 2025-12-31; the branch no longer receives security or bug fixes from the PHP project.

constraints: Keep .php-version, .tool-versions, composer.json require.php and config.platform.php, composer.lock platform.php, CI matrices, and container images on one supported PHP release line.
Confirm Composer packages and extensions build on the target PHP and reinstall dependencies after changing the runtime.

steps.title: Raise the PHP version
steps.instructions: Change the reported declaration from PHP 8.1 to a supported release (see the replacement), using the project's existing version manager.

steps.title: Align other PHP version surfaces
steps.instructions: Update CI setup-php versions, Dockerfile `php:` images, composer.json require.php and config.platform.php, and composer.lock platform.php so they agree.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active runtime is the intended release.
Validate and reinstall dependencies on the new PHP.
Validate the Composer project and run the PHPUnit suite on the new PHP.

rules.title: swiftmailer/swiftmailer is abandoned
rules.summary: Packagist marks swiftmailer/swiftmailer as abandoned and no longer maintained, and the author suggests using symfony/mailer instead. The Symfony project set Swiftmailer's end of maintenance for the end of November 2021.

constraints: Preserve message construction, transport configuration, and delivery behavior while moving from Swiftmailer to Symfony Mailer.
Keep composer.json, composer.lock, and any package that still requires swiftmailer/swiftmailer consistent after the replacement.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Remove swiftmailer/swiftmailer from composer.json and require symfony/mailer (and any transport packages the project needs), then run `composer update`.

steps.title: Migrate Swiftmailer usages
steps.instructions: Replace reported Swift_Mailer and Swift_Message requires, use statements, constructors, and newInstance calls with the Symfony Mailer Email and Mailer APIs.

verification.purpose: Confirm the Composer project is valid and symfony/mailer is installed.
Validate the Composer project and run the PHPUnit suite with the replacement mailer.

rules.title: zendframework/zend-stdlib is abandoned
rules.summary: Packagist marks zendframework/zend-stdlib as abandoned and no longer maintained, and the author suggests using laminas/laminas-stdlib instead. The Laminas Project announced that Zend Framework packages were archived and marked abandoned on Packagist when the project moved to Laminas.

sources.title: Endings and Beginnings: Goodbye, and Please Welcome the Laminas Project!

constraints: Preserve array and parameter helper behavior while moving from Zend\Stdlib to Laminas\Stdlib.
Keep composer.json, composer.lock, and any package that still requires zendframework/zend-stdlib consistent after the replacement.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Remove zendframework/zend-stdlib from composer.json and require laminas/laminas-stdlib, then run `composer update`.

steps.title: Migrate Zend\Stdlib usages
steps.instructions: Replace reported Zend\Stdlib use statements, ArrayUtils calls, and Parameters constructors with the Laminas\Stdlib equivalents.

verification.purpose: Confirm the Composer project is valid and laminas/laminas-stdlib is installed.
Validate the Composer project and run the PHPUnit suite with the replacement package.

rules.title: doctrine/cache is abandoned
rules.summary: Packagist marks doctrine/cache as abandoned and no longer maintained.

constraints: Keep composer.json and composer.lock consistent after removing doctrine/cache, and check that no other package still requires it.
Preserve existing behavior while replacing the abandoned package; review its public API usage before choosing a replacement.

steps.title: Replace the abandoned package
steps.instructions: Remove doctrine/cache from composer.json and replace it with a maintained alternative that fits how the project uses it, then run `composer update`.

verification.purpose: Confirm the Composer project is valid and installs without the abandoned package.
Validate the Composer project and run the PHPUnit suite after the replacement.
